steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each requirement needs a test case, each failed test a retest, and sign-off comes before go-live.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Sign-off missing before go-live
findings.fix: Do not go live until sign-off

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

       Fix: Retest before go-live.
[high] signoff.md:19  Sign-off missing before go-live.
       Fix: Do not go live until sign-off.
[medium] retest-log.csv:26  Requirement with no test case.
       Fix: Write the test case.
Not checked: Behaviour in production.
pros: Checks a requirement with no test case, a failed test with no retest, and a sign-off missing before go-live.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-hris-uat-checklist skill on the records for this review.
